_comment: The look of the bar: day (the normal light look), night (a dark look) or auto (night by the clock, see below). Default day = today's look. Read at server start (--look-config to use another file).
_comment_night: auto: night from..to by the Pi's wall clock (local time, fixed hours, no location). The Pi has no RTC: before the clock is set (year before 2026) auto shows day. The Settings row and the menu hold change the look until the server restarts.
